TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: turbo, which phones home unless told not to
DO_NOT_TRACK: turbo and every tool that honours the convention
WORKER_RUNTIME: the worker image CMD and the k8s worker command, the worker target of the Dockerfile
SSR_API_BASE_URL: apps/client/web's SSR server, parsed by its own schema in apps/client/web/src/config
ACCOUNTS_MAX: apps/client/web and apps/client/studio's SSR servers, parsed by @vp/queries' parseClientEnv from their src/lib/config: how many accounts one browser holds at once
SSR_DEV_TOKEN_URL: apps/client/web and apps/client/studio's SSR servers, parsed by their own schemas in src/lib/config, and demo/start.sh: where the server reaches dev-token serve for the demo personas
LIVEKIT_KEYS: the LiveKit server, infra/k8s/base/livekit.yaml: the key and secret pair it signs and verifies tokens with, built from LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
LIVEKIT_CONFIG: the LiveKit server, infra/k8s/base/livekit.yaml: its whole configuration as YAML
NODE_IP: the LiveKit server, infra/k8s/base/livekit.yaml: the address it advertises to clients, set per environment instead of discovered through a public STUN server
VITE_WEB_URL: apps/client/web and apps/client/studio at build time: the web app's public origin, the same value the API reads as WEB_URL
